essence: Doing-a-little, knowing-a-little, clinging in may-I-grow-never-cease shape, sequence-cutting was-am-will, must in mine-to-do shape — five functions, one veil over full consciousness, distinct-yet-undistinct. Nature poises the three strands past telling apart. Deciding, prideing, resolving organ; ten senses ordered; five commons defined by having-nothing-more; five element-offices: room, life, burn-cook, refresh-flow, uphold.

rasa.sthayibhava: vismaya (wonder) at littles catalogued and elements officed
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: each little defined by its lack, each element by its work. Inventory relished.
